{{Quote|Quaint theatrics won't work. Brutality, carnage&mdash;that's how you break the Republic.|Moff Dracen|<ref name="Toxic Clash">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Toxic Clash|Quesh}}</ref>}}
'''Dracen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] stationed on [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Biography==
Dracen was a Moff of the Sith Empire's [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the Cold War. He was known for his assignment to the [[Atmosphere/Legends|toxic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Quesh.<ref name="Codex" />

Quesh was one of many worlds during the Cold War that was a site of undeclared war between the Sith Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Republic operations there involved the creation and processing of powerful [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] which threatened to unbalance Republic and Imperial forces.<ref name="Codex" />

Moff Dracen's assignment on Quesh involved sabotaging Republic operations there. To this end, Drace was aligned with the local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="Codex" />

Dracen eventually led the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to an invasion of [[Broga Masrii]]'s [[Broga's Palace|Palace]] on [[Quesh]], eventually General [[Korvan]] of the Galactic Republic saw an opportunity to capture or eliminate Moff Dracen camped out in Broga's Palace. Dracen's barricade was hit by a Republic SpecForces Squad and an unidentified affiliate with the Republic, Dracen was taken in to Republic prison for questioning.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Because of the option to kill Moff Dracen, the missions given by General Korvan on Quesh take place after Dracen's missions.
